messages:
amelia.partnerships: Quick thread to align on multi-vendor marketplace onboarding + joint announcement rhythm. Goal: AWS/GCP/Azure listings + optional hardware partner SKU (Acer appliance) + SI integration paragraph. Need final publisher IDs, SKU map, trial UX (no-CC?), legal snips, assets, and press timeline.

raj.legal: We can adapt the standard marketplace T&C per vendor. For no-CC trials we must add abuse/chargeback and explicit opt-in before billing. Also: Azure requires an SLA blurb for private plans and AWS wants refund language for trials that auto-charge. I'll prepare EN/DE/FR drafts and a DPA link.

leo.product: SKU plan: 
- redwood-saas-basic (14d trial, metered)
- redwood-saas-pro (subscription + overage)
- redwood-edge-acer (hardware add-on, one-time + install)
Bundle: redwood-saas-with-edge (bundle SKU). Metering unit = per-10k-token-block. Example invoice line: "Redwood Inference - 10k token units x 3500 units = $12,250" (placeholder).

amelia.partnerships: @acer-hw can confirm whether hardware SKU requires separate ordering flow or can be linked as "add-on" in marketplace? We also want SI mention: certified integrators can offer install services; need a short copy snippet.

acer-hw: For the Acer appliance we prefer a separate SKU to track shipments. We can support a bundle link from SaaS listing -> order form for appliance provisioning. Logistics: 4-6 week lead time for EU shipments unless inventory flagged as "express".

morgan.ops: Ops checklist:
- AWS: sandbox publisher id created: RBW-AWS-SBX-46. Will run private-offer flow tonight.
- GCP: partner portal request pending; service account created: redwood-marketplace@redwood-prod.iam.gserviceaccount.com
- Azure: tenant verification in progress; MS contact assigned.
We need webhook endpoints accessible: `/marketplace/provision` and `/marketplace/entitlements`. Ensure mutual TLS for vendor calls.

raj.legal: Security note: vendor portals may post customer PII in provisioning payloads. Ensure we only log minimal fields and redact email/phone in logs. Add small blurb to listing privacy: "We process provisioning data to fulfill orders; see DPA."

leo.product: Manifest example (paste to PR):
```
{
  "offerId": "redwood-inference-2026",
  "publisherId": "<vendor-publisher-id>",
  "skus": [
    {"id": "redwood-saas-basic", "pricingModel": "metered", "trialDays": 14},
    {"id": "redwood-saas-pro", "pricingModel": "subscription"},
    {"id": "redwood-edge-acer", "pricingModel": "one_time"}
  ],
  "metadata": {"eu_data_only": false, "supports_vpc_peering": true, "edge_addon": true}
}
```

amelia.partnerships: Marketing ask: hero image (1200x400), 10s demo GIF, 60-char headline, and a partner co-brand lockup for Acer. Also we need a joint announcement plan: partner preview -> partner technical readout -> joint blog + customer webinar. Proposed dates: preview 2024-06-25, announcement 2024-07-09. Thoughts?

yvonne.marketing: Love the timeline. Marketing will own hero + GIF + co-brand lockup. Need logos from Acer and a short approved partner quote. Also: press checklist (legal sign-off on customer terms + any logos usage agreements).

acer-hw: We'll provide logo + partner quote. Legal IP usage T&Cs are in our standard partner kit (link incoming).

morgan.ops: Running sandbox upload now. If manifest validation fails I'll paste error. Also will spin up an ephemeral webhook endpoint for testing; will share URL. Reminder: set publisher contact to infra@redwood.com for all vendor portals.

raj.legal: Action items from legal: finalize localized T&C + DPA link, prepare short trial billing clause, and review joint announcement copy for any contractual claims (due Tue 12:00 UTC).

leo.product: Product actions: finalize SKU slugs + pricing matrix, add example invoice lines & quickstart curl snippets to PR (due Mon EOD). I'll include a short SI paragraph: "Certified integrators available for on-prem installs and migration".

amelia.partnerships: Ops actions: complete AWS sandbox private-offer test and GCP manifest submission (due Mon midnight). Marketing actions: assets + co-brand by Wed. Acer to provide logos and shipping SLAs by Tue.

yvonne.marketing: Will schedule creative drop-in review Tuesday 10:30 PT. Also prepping webinar draft outline for July 16.

morgan.ops: Sandbox upload done. Validation: manifest OK for AWS, GCP portal returned 422 for `edge_addon` unknown metadata key. Will remove vendor-specific key and re-submit. Posting logs: `manifest_validation: OK`, `metadata_warning: edge_addon removed for GCP`.

leo.product: Noted re: metadata. I'll adjust manifest to use `edge_compatible` instead.

amelia.partnerships: Thanks team. Follow-up sync Friday 9am PT in #partnerships to confirm partner preview packet is ready. If you can't make it, drop final artifacts here. :rocket:
